name: bg-n8n-mcp
description: BAUER GROUP n8n MCP Server — OAuth 2.1 MCP server for n8n, fronting n8n-mcp as a remote connector with each user's own n8n API key
author: BAUER GROUP <info@bauer-group.com>
// engines: Node 24 is Active LTS (security support through 2028-04-30) and is what the
production image runs. Node 26 (Current, LTS from October 2026) is exercised
in CI so the bump is a one-line change rather than a discovery.
// packageManager: pnpm enforces this field itself (manage-package-manager-versions, on by
default), so it is the single source of truth for the version — including in
the Docker build, which installs pnpm from npm rather than through Corepack.
Corepack stopped shipping with Node at 25.0.0; a Corepack-based Dockerfile
would break the day the base image moves to node:26.

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage
